## Step

1. Navigate to Loyalty App > Content > Add Content.

2. Click to view content details, delete or duplicate content. 

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="746" height="255" style="width: 746px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3.

- Modify existing app related content

* Delete or duplicate content.
